prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: An extended family gathering at home, grandparents, parents, cousins and a baby. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Family Visit". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Aunt and uncle, cousin, son.
Daughter, baby, every one.
Grandfather, parent, welcome here.
Young and old, come very near.
Husband, wife, one happy home.
Visit, talk, and never feel alone.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
